description: Click a DOM element. Use browser_canvas for charts/canvas. If stuck_warning=true, stop and use browser_map. Pass mark: N to click a numbered element from browser_map({ visual: true/"auto" }) without any DOM re-scan.

app.description: Electron app name configured in config.json under 'electron'.

backendNodeId.description: Raw CDP backendNodeId for direct hardware targeting.

id.description: Ref ID from browser_map (e.g. 'w:42'). Primary targeting method. DO NOT SPAM. If stuck_warning is returned, stop retrying and call browser_map first.

include_map.description: Set true to include a full updated page_map in the response. Default false — omit when you already have ref IDs or don't need a DOM refresh.

intent.description: Semantic description of the action (e.g. 'submit login form'). Weavetab checks learned memory first — if a high-confidence selector is found it clicks immediately without DOM resolution. Falls through to normal resolution on a miss; does not error.

label.description: Visible text or aria-label to click.

mark.description: Mark number from browser_map({ visual: true/"auto" }). Clicks the center of the numbered badge seen in the annotated screenshot. Zero DOM walk — instant coordinate dispatch. Use when the page is canvas/WebGL and DOM refs are unavailable.

selector.description: CSS selector of the element to click.

tab_id.description: Execute in a specific tab instead of active.

target.description: CSS selector or query string. Alias for selector.

x.description: Raw X coordinate. Use for precise positional clicks when element ID is not available.

y.description: Raw Y coordinate. Use for precise positional clicks when element ID is not available.

name: browser_click
